_provenance.nature: A real backtest IQRF_V2 itself already ran and recorded, over real historical RELIANCE 1-min data, 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-17 (13 real trading days). Not synthetic, not hand-authored like sample_data/ -- but also not live money or today's trades. Extracted strictly read-only: no IQRF_V2 code was executed, no IQRF_V2 file was modified.
_provenance.known_gaps: The source report stores net_pnl and r_multiple per trade but not a quantity/commission/slippage breakdown, so each trade here sets quantity=1, gross_pnl=net_pnl, commission=0, slippage_cost=0 rather than inventing a split IQRF_V2 itself didn't report. day_realized_pnl_from_trades is cross-checked against day_realized_pnl_reference_report (IQRF_V2's own independently-computed daily_pnl) below; small drift is expected since IQRF_V2's daily_pnl already nets commission/slippage that per_trade's net_pnl may compute slightly differently -- this drift is itself surfaced through this agent's own pnl_reconciliation_drift check.
